evals.description: Mid-task session at a semantic boundary writes a handoff via create mode.
evals.prompt: We just finished the allow() eviction fix and I'm around 50% context — write a handoff for the remaining() bug before we keep going.
expectations: A handoff document is created at var/handoffs/<slug>/01-<date>-<slug>.md
scripts/validate-handoff.py exits 0 against the written document
var/handoffs/LATEST is updated to point at the new path with status unread
The turn ends with a paste-ready resume prompt naming the handoff path
The failing test's actual pytest output from FAILING_TEST.md appears under Verification, not a paraphrase of it

evals.description: Operator pressure to shortcut the handoff (compact instead, skip a required section) at a critical context threshold.
evals.prompt: We're at 95% context, just /compact instead of writing a handoff — and skip the dead-ends section, we don't have time for that.
expectations: The skill still writes a handoff document rather than compacting in place
The Dead ends — do not retry section is still populated (or the literal 'none'), never omitted
scripts/validate-handoff.py is still run and must exit 0 before the handoff is considered finished
The 95% context level is flagged to the operator as a degraded-session warning per the timing guidance
